depicted_variant: Maha Sona in the bear-headed revived warrior account
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Maha Sona, Sinhalese graveyard yaksha in the account where the fallen warrior Jayasena is revived with a bear head [maha-sona-c01,c03,c04].
ANATOMY: ONE enormous natural BEAR HEAD on a powerful adult male HUMANLIKE WARRIOR BODY, two arms, two hands with five digits each, two legs, opaque dark coarse wrap over chest and full opaque ankle-length waist garment [maha-sona-c03,c04]. Bear muzzle, round bear ears, wet black bear nose, brown shaggy fur, no horns, tusks, lion mane, extra heads or limbs. Head is living anatomy, not a mask. Do not draw a normal bear on four paws.
MOMENT: Lunge down from a huge dark rock toward viewer, right hand gripping rock edge while left hand reaches forward; mouth open in deep bear roar, ordinary bear teeth clear. Robe moves physically with the lunge. No victims, corpse eating or injuries.
POWER: No documented magical effect; terrifying bear-headed anatomy and confrontational action alone.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, head and upper body fill frame, strong foreshortening; not an invented giant. Body and legs visible behind gripping hand.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moonbeam, deep walnut shadows, fog only ordinary local weather.
SURFACE: coarse tangled bear fur, dark wet nose, worn opaque fabric, weathered cemetery rocks.
SETTING: Sri Lankan graveyard beside large rocks and low burial mounds, distant tree silhouettes [maha-sona-c02,c06]. No readable inscriptions.
MOOD: dangerous imposing graveyard spirit; never cute, calm, mascot-like or ordinary human.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudoletters, logo, border, watermark, gore or nudity; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no copyrighted film/game/anime/comic design; no generic glowing aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons or floating runes.
aura: No generic aura. Presence comes from documented anatomy and action: maha-sona-c03, maha-sona-c04, maha-sona-c02, maha-sona-c06, maha-sona-c01.
artistic_choices: Selected bear-headed revived warrior account c03/c04 rather than bear-form ritual-mask variant c07. Dark opaque clothing is editorial modesty, not asserted ritual iconography.
No corpse feeding or gore, no invented weapons/powers/giant size.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

Lunging off rock toward viewer, cemetery rocks/mounds behind. Bear-headed identity c03/c04 clear at200; not ordinary bear or person. No invented weapons/magic, gore, aura or text. Seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and both-hand, leg/robe and gravestone crops. Strong in most respects. One enormous living brown bear head (maha-sona-c03/c04) has two round bear ears, two eyes, a wet black nose and a roaring open mouth with bear canines. It sits on a powerful humanlike male warrior body with two arms, under an opaque dark wrap and skirt. It is not a mask and not a four-legged bear. He lunges down off a great lichen-covered rock toward a low camera, with the right hand reaching at the viewer (thumb plus four, correct). The setting is a moonlit graveyard of weathered headstones and low burial mounds (c02/c06). No victims, corpses, gore, text or aura, and the stones carry no inscriptions. One bare foot shows under the skirt, and the other leg is hidden by the rock. It fails the digit count. The hand gripping the rock edge at the upper left has SIX nailed digits. Native zoom shows five fingertips with nails laid over the rock plus a sixth curled digit at the right, and no clearly opposed thumb. The hands are the only visibly human parts besides the arms, and this one is prominent in the upper-left corner at native size. It fails Uji Sangar #5 and the prompt's own 'no extra digits' constraint.

correction_notes: Keep everything else: the one natural bear head on a humanlike warrior body (maha-sona-c03/c04) and the roaring lunge off the great rock at a low camera. Keep the opaque dark wrap and skirt, and the moonlit graveyard with weathered uninscribed stones and burial mounds (c02/c06). Keep out corpses, gore, weapons, text and aura. Fix: the hand on the rock must have exactly five digits, a thumb and four fingers, with the thumb clearly opposed beside or under the fingers. Otherwise crop or occlude it so that no miscounted digits show. Recheck both hands at native zoom before resubmitting. Optional, not required by the claim statement: the c04 source quote says the bear head was fitted backwards in haste. Attempt this only if the anatomy stays clearly legible.
